scores.evidence: The new p-start expect text is in です・ます. Its three sentences are short and parse cleanly: 「初めてのフォルダでは、信頼の確認が出ます。自分で作ったフォルダなので、承認します。入力欄の上に `cc-practice` が表示されます。」 It uses the same term as cc-05 (「信頼の確認が出ます」) and cc-09 (「信頼の確認に答えます」), so the later lessons can treat it as known. The score stays at 3 because the stiff spots in loop-lead and surfaces-same have not changed.

measure.mjs gives prose 1659 (budget 1,200–2,400) and est 16.1 min (must be ≤ 20; estMinutes 16). lessons:lint --strict reports 0 errors and 0 warnings. The new expect text has 3 sentences, which is within the paragraph budget.

「信頼の確認」 is plain Japanese, and the expect text says how to answer it: approve, because you made the folder yourself. It does not say what is being trusted (see niceToHave). push, エンジン and npm are still unexplained (niceToHave, carried), so the score stays at 3.
Carried over: the lesson declares jp only. Every string is in Japanese, and both links name their destination.

niceToHave: practice-steps: p-start's expect now includes an action (「承認します」), but expect should say what the learner will see. The step would read more clearly if the dialog were named and the action moved to hint — 「初めてのフォルダでは、信頼の確認が出ます。自分で作ったフォルダなので、承認します。」→「初めてのフォルダでは、このフォルダを信頼するかの確認が出ます。自分で作ったフォルダなので、承認します。」 (this also says what 「信頼」 refers to)
